reading.action: Carry the drained Sentinel core down to the floor-2 brazier and set it in the flame; watch with fire-sense whether it absorbs essence on its own, jumpstart it with a little of his own held ember if not; then climb back up to the third floor and sweep it carefully for additional threats.

checkA_core_in_flame.note: NAT 20 / CRIT — breakthrough Essence-read. The drained core sits inert to the brazier alone; primed with a thread of his own ember it WAKES and drinks greedily, then self-feeds from the flame and banks a held charge. He gains perfect insight: it is an essence-vessel that fills when fed and keeps what it takes until drawn out. EXPENDITURE (feeds ember out) -> no affinity tick. Qualifying Essence Infusion demo (self-supply bind into an object) -> Apprentice 3 -> 4 within-rung roll-up (+1 continuous).

checkB_floor3_sweep.note: Sharp sweep — the third floor reads CLEAR of active threats, and walking it slow he reads its purpose: a chamber built around the furnace and its keeper, shaped for the making and breaking of metal. No danger, no new threat introduced.

reading.result: CORE PRIMED + IDENTIFIED (crit): an essence-vessel charging in the brazier coals at the floor-2 stairfoot. SKILL: Essence Infusion Apprentice 3 -> 4 (+1). ITEM ACQUIRED: Furnace-heart. FLOOR 3: swept clear, no threats; read as a forge/furnace chamber. COST: Focus 72 -> 64 (-8 jumpstart), Stamina 32 -> 27 (-5 labor); HP 70 unchanged. XP +10 -> 20/250. Equip unchanged (Burning Anger in hand). The way up off floor 3 stands open and unclimbed; the core fills below. STOP at his decision point — floor clear, core charging, climb ahead. NO assumed next action. NO Tower reset.
